integrity: The source paper proves the singular-point existence criterion; the new contribution is the local node/cusp and arithmetic branch classification with its complete pencil-wide census. Finite enumeration supplements rather than establishes the universal proof.
limitations: All claims concern only F_q-rational singular points, for odd prime powers q, of the precise Asgarli--Ghioca pencil. The global geometric singular locus and global smoothness conjecture remain unproved. In the 7|(q-1) regime, the genus-three point count is not replaced by a uniform elementary formula.
title: Rational singularity types and Frobenius splitting in a plane-filling pencil
